data.title: 爱夏·香料摊前的比较
data.action: 左手托起一只香料罐，右手把清单压在摊位边缘
data.description: 爱夏停在市集香料摊前，左手将一只小陶罐托到视线下方，右手把采购单压在木柜台边缘。旅行斗篷的兜帽垂在肩后，马尾和发带完整露出，挎包闭合。棚布投下柔和阴影，罐口与手背接住摊位外的日光；横幅背景以空置摊架、布幌和石墙交代市集。
data.promptProse: Beneath the striped awning, adult Aisha examines a ceramic spice jar in her left palm while her right hand presses the shopping slip against the counter. Forest-green cloak layers over cream shirt and trousers, hood down and cross-body satchel closed. The medium-wide view includes jar rows with empty stall frames and stone walls beyond. Daylight catches ceramic rims at the awning edge, softly illuminating her face while the counter's deeper shelves remain shaded.
